overview: Dedicated Leo-only polish for Find Us on memories.songara.uk/moment. No letter, no new Moments, no redesign. Rebuilt Leo from J2000-relative geometry fitted into a locked artwork frame matching the supplied lion PNG aspect ratio so stars, lines, labels, and overlay cannot drift across viewports. Replaced blotchy overlay with a blue-ink extract from Ref B (parchment/stars/lines removed, holes inpainted, lightly blurred). Discovery follows an Eulerian sketchPath (ν→sickle→body→close) so edges draw as one continuous pencil walk. Removed cursor:help; hover still shows names on completed stars. Validated with typecheck, eslint, docker rebuild, and three screenshot iterations under docs/artifacts/moments/find-us/leo-polish/.
executiveSummary: Leo is now freeze-ready: astronomically grounded stick figure, locked lion+stars alignment, continuous sketch draw order, consistent pointer cursor, and warm amber palette — ready to move to the paper/letter transition as the next Moment.
userVisibleChanges: Leo star positions and edges match classic sickle + hindquarters with ν Leonis and Denebola↔Zosma
Draw order follows a continuous Eulerian pencil walk instead of jumping around the graph
Lion overlay rebuilt from supplied atlas art without baked-in star/line artefacts
Stars, lines, labels, and lion stay locked together across desktop, wide, and mobile
Browser cursor stays default/pointer; completed stars still show names on hover
architectureChanges: Leo artwork uses fit:fill (SVG preserveAspectRatio none) inside an aspect-matched frame shared with star coordinates
Optional constellation.sketchPath drives edge draw order for consecutive strokes
Edge stroke animation uses pathLength=1 to avoid dashed artefacts
knownLimitations: Star-to-anatomy registration is frame-fitted from J2000 + Ref B aspect, not a full landmark solver against the atlas plate
Lion overlay still carries soft parchment-extract texture after inpaint/blur
recommendedNextMilestone: Freeze Leo. Next implementation task: paper / letter transition Moment — continuous sky→paper reveal and letter begin, without reopening Leo geometry.
